en-US.name: billy
en-US.summary: Play one configured audiobook from a self-hosted endpoint.
en-US.description: A development skill for jamestelfer/billy. It plays one externally configured, non-sensitive audiobook through a self-hosted endpoint reached over Tailscale Funnel.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask billy to play the hobbit
Alexa, ask billy to listen to the hobbit

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Development only. Ask Billy to play the one title configured by the operator.
